summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for acute on chronic shortness of breath, pleuritic chest pain, and leg swelling, with hypoxemia and hypercarbia. Evaluation revealed an exacerbation of diastolic heart failure and obstructive lung disease, worsened by medication non-adherence and opioid use. She developed respiratory acidosis with metabolic compensation, requiring careful oxygen management. Cellulitis of the left leg was treated with antibiotics, and her urinary retention and constipation were managed supportively. Depression and anxiety were addressed with continued medications and outpatient referral. She improved with diuresis, bronchodilators, and infection treatment, and was discharged home with updated medication instructions, smoking cessation support, and follow-up plans.
problems: Acute on chronic diastolic heart failure
Delirium due to conditions classified elsewhere
